# ledger_audit_entries (Data Source)

The audit log, newest first as the API lists it. Needs a token with the audit grant. Details are the API's own JSON and never contain secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The latest commitment changes. Needs a token with the audit grant.
data "ledger_audit_entries" "commitments" {
  action_prefix = "commitment."
  max_items     = 50
}

output "actions" {
  value = [for e in data.ledger_audit_entries.commitments.items : e.action]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (List of String) Only these actions.
- `action_prefix` (String) Only actions with this prefix.
- `actor_kind` (List of String) Only these actor kinds: user, token, system or anonymous.
- `actor_token_id` (String) Only this token's actions.
- `actor_user_id` (String) Only this user's actions.
- `at_gte` (String) Only entries at or after this time (RFC 3339).
- `at_lt` (String) Only entries before this time (RFC 3339).
- `max_items` (Number) The most items to read (1 to 10000); 1000 when unset.
- `target_id` (String) Only this target.
- `target_type` (String) Only this target type.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API had more items than max_items; narrow the filters or raise max_items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What was done.
- `actor_kind` (String) user, token, system or anonymous.
- `actor_token_id` (String) The token, or null.
- `actor_user_id` (String) The user, or null.
- `at` (String) When it happened (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `details` (String) Details as the API's JSON object.
- `id` (String) The entry identifier.
- `target_id` (String) The object acted on, or null.
- `target_type` (String) The kind of object acted on, or null.
